Name: Alchemist's Dubai Chocolate Overdrive Series
Author: BTypeAlchemist
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#999999]This mod expands the original DOZZONCOO concept into a full [b]"Dubai Chocolate" cooking system[/b].
DOZZONCOO is transformed into a versatile core ingredient, allowing players to craft a wide variety of desserts and even unconventional dishes inspired by rich chocolate-based cuisine.
From simple baked goods to elaborate sweets, this mod adds depth and creativity to the cooking experience in Stardew Valley.
All recipes can be purchased from [b]Gus’s Saloon[/b], integrating naturally into the game's progression.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#999999]Install SMAPI [/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999]Install Content Patcher [/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999]Download and extract this mod into your [/color]

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][color=#999999]folder [/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999]Launch the game via SMAPI [/color][/*]
[/list][color=#999999]※ Make sure all required dependency mods are installed before running the game.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[*][color=#999999]Adds [b]30+ Dubai Chocolate recipes[/b] [/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999]Uses [b]DOZZONCOO as a core ingredient in every recipe[/b] [/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999]Introduces a [b]thematic cooking system centered around chocolate[/b] [/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999]Includes [b]varied recipe types[/b] (bread, desserts, fusion dishes, etc.) [/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999]Applies [b]balanced ingredient distribution[/b] (including crops and cooking materials) [/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999]Seamlessly integrates with the [b]vanilla cooking progression[/b] [/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999]Recipes are [b]available for purchase at Gus’s Saloon[/b][/color]
